title: status_polling allowed exactly the 15 s the environment poll plus a silent reply take, so it failed whenever the poll came late
summary: test_focuser_primaluce_simulator status_polling waits 15 s for FOCUSER_TEMPERATURE ALERT after arming a silent EXT_T reply. The environment is polled every 10 s and a silent reply costs the 5 s serial read timeout, so the ALERT arrives up to 15 s later. On Linux it failed 2 of 3 isolated reruns and in all three full baseline runs.

resolution.evidence: 20261022212521-61cf-primalucelib/verification.md: the window is 20 s with the cadence documented in the test; 3 of 3 isolated reruns and the recorded run pass. The assertion itself is unchanged.
